_comment: PEMF -- officers.
Everything about hiring officers lives here and is meant to be edited.
A file that breaks a rule is rejected at load with the reason in pemf.log,
and the rest still loads.
TRAITS: every officer has talents, and may also have a FLAW. Both are
rolled at random, so two Master Bosuns are not the same man. A flaw is
just a trait with a negative value -- the schema does not treat it
specially, and neither should you when writing one.
TARGETS -- what a trait may change. ONLY these five. Anything else is
rejected at load, because PEMF will not pretend to change something it
cannot:
loot        percent added to everything the crew plunders.
Negative loses you part of the take.
morale      points on the crew's temper.
cargoGuard  percent of storm cargo losses prevented.
Negative and more goes over the side.
discretion  percent slower suspicion under false colours.
Negative and they see through you sooner.
surgeon     percent of crew losses recovered -- men who would have
died and did not. Negative is a butcher.
Write the text so a player knows what it DOES. 'He counts a prize twice'
is flavour; the number after it is the promise.
bios: Sailed nine years under a captain he will not name, and does not care to be asked.
Lost a brother off Campeche and has been looking for the ship that did it ever since.
Was a merchant's clerk once. Says the sea is honester work, and means it.
Came ashore with a pardon in his pocket and drank the value of it in a week.
Keeps a psalter he cannot read and a knife he plainly can use.
Was pressed into a King's ship at fifteen and has had opinions about kings since.
Has buried two wives and three captains, and speaks better of the wives.
Talks little, works steadily, and has never been found where he should not be.
Swears he has seen the Maelstrom. Nobody argues, which he takes for agreement.
Carries a Spanish coin with a hole through it and will not say what stopped it.
Learned his trade in the Mediterranean and thinks little of Caribbean weather.
Was quartermaster on a ship that voted itself to pieces, and learned from it.
Deserted a plantation and would rather hang than see one again.
Can read a sky better than most men read a chart.
Owes money in four ports and remembers exactly which four.
Turned down a boatswain's berth on a King's ship and has never once regretted it.
Reads the wind by the feel of it on his neck and has yet to be wrong.
Was three days on a spar after the Isabella went down, and does not discuss it.
Keeps a ledger of every man who ever cheated him. It is not a short ledger.
Buried his share twice and dug it up twice, both times in a hurry.
Speaks four languages badly and swears in all of them fluently.
Once talked a Spanish captain out of a fight and into a trade, and got the better of it.
Has a wife in Bridgetown who believes he is a customs clerk.
Sailed with Morgan, or says he did, and nobody has found him out yet.
Will not sail on a Friday and will not say why.
Was a ship's boy on the vessel that took the Cadiz plate fleet.
Came aboard with nothing but a sea chest and a very good knife.
Can splice, caulk, cook and cut a man's leg off, in roughly that order of skill.
Has been marooned twice and rescued twice, by different crews.
Every port has a story about him and no two of them agree.

skills.name: A Sharp Eye for Plunder
skills.text: Counts a prize's worth before the smoke clears, and little goes astray

skills.name: Prize Master
skills.text: Knows which hull is worth taking and which is worth burning

skills.name: A Hard Bargain
skills.text: Has never paid an asking price in his life, and sells dearer than you would

skills.name: A Fair Share
skills.text: The men trust his arithmetic, which is worth more than the arithmetic

skills.name: Well Liked
skills.text: The hands work the harder for him and none of them could tell you why

skills.name: An Old Salt
skills.text: Has weathered worse, says so, and the crew believe him

skills.name: Stows Her Well
skills.text: Cargo lashed his way stays aboard when the sea comes over the rail

skills.name: Ready at the Pumps
skills.text: Has the hatches battened before the first squall reaches you

skills.name: Close-Mouthed Ashore
skills.text: Drinks in port without ever once saying whose ship he sails

skills.name: A Way With Papers
skills.text: Produces a manifest for any flag you care to fly, and it reads true

skills.name: A Steady Hand With a Needle
skills.text: Men who would have died of their wounds get up and walk instead

skills.name: Ship's Physic
skills.text: Keeps the fever off the lower deck, which no one thanks him for

skills.name: FLAW: Drinks
skills.text: Found insensible at the change of watch more often than not

skills.name: FLAW: Light Fingers
skills.text: Somehow the count never quite matches what came aboard

skills.name: FLAW: A Loose Tongue
skills.text: Tells the whole tavern whose ship he sails and what she carries

skills.name: FLAW: Careless With Cargo
skills.text: Stows in a hurry, and the sea finds every rope he did not pull tight

skills.name: FLAW: More Butcher Than Surgeon
skills.text: Men carried below to him do not often come back up

skills.name: FLAW: Hated Forward
skills.text: The hands work slower when he is watching, and stop when he is not

skills.name: Quick With a Count
skills.text: Tallies a hold in half the time and misses nothing

skills.name: Knows a Buyer
skills.text: Always has somebody ashore who will take the cargo quietly

skills.name: Keeps Order
skills.text: Settles a quarrel before it becomes a grievance

skills.name: Shares the Watch
skills.text: Stands his turn with the hands instead of above them

skills.name: Keeps a Dry Hold
skills.text: Finds the leak before the cargo does

skills.name: A Forger's Hand
skills.text: Papers, seals and manifests, all convincing enough to pass

skills.name: Cold Nerve Ashore
skills.text: Answers a harbourmaster's questions without blinking once

skills.name: Clean Hands
skills.text: Boils his instruments, which the men mock until they need him

skills.name: FLAW: Gambles
skills.text: Loses his share, then borrows against yours

skills.name: FLAW: A Bully
skills.text: Gets the work done and leaves the crew hating the doing of it

skills.name: FLAW: Superstitious
skills.text: Will not work in a blow until he has said the right words

skills.name: FLAW: Boastful in Drink
skills.text: Names the ship, the captain and the cargo before the second cup

skills.name: FLAW: A Shaking Hand
skills.text: Steady enough sober, and he is not often sober

roles.name: Quartermaster
roles.blurb: a fairer share, and a crew that knows it

roles.name: Bosun
roles.blurb: the hands work faster and grumble less

roles.name: Master Gunner
roles.blurb: the broadsides tell, and the prizes are richer

roles.name: Carpenter
roles.blurb: less goes over the side in heavy weather
